title: SFHo/FRDM v1.03 real-table audit and occupation closure
source: University of Basel, M. Hempel; Hempel (2015) arXiv:1410.6337; Fiorillo et al. (2025) arXiv:2509.13322v2 App. C.1

provenance.version_note: The four SFHo/FRDM archives are v1.03 data (2012-07-09); manual_v1.04 of 2012-12-19 only added the IUFSU table, so manual and data versions are consistent.

closure.definition: xi * nprime_N(T, mstar_N, mu_nonrel_N - SigmaV_N) == X_N * nB, with xi from the single-particle table

xi_composition_identity.definition: xi ?= 1 - (nB - X_n nB - X_p nB)/n0 with n0 = 0.15824150805 fm^-3
